project.topic: AI coding agents and the future of software engineering
project.target_audience: Senior engineers and engineering leaders on X

chunks.text: Engineers report a shift from typing to specifying.

insights.insight: Code generation is solved; engineering judgment is the new bottleneck.
insights.why_it_matters: Hiring, review processes, and code ownership all rebuild around judgment, not throughput.

angles.title: Judgment is the new bottleneck
angles.thesis: AI agents make implementation cheap. The scarce skill is deciding what should exist and what should not.
angles.hook: Code generation is solved. Knowing what to build still is not.
angles.rationale: Contrarian, defensible, ladders into a strong specific claim.

beats: Engineering judgment is the new edge

output.text:
Code generation is solved. Engineering judgment still is not.

The best engineers in 2026 are the people who can frame the right problem, constrain the agent, and notice when the answer is subtly wrong.

evidence.summary: Industry signal but no formal benchmark

output.notes: Voice is sharp. Trim adverbs in the second sentence.

revision.text:
Code generation is becoming a commodity. Engineering judgment is not.

The best engineers in 2026 frame the right problem, constrain the agent, and catch the answers that are subtly wrong.
